'''FK Třinec''' is a [[association football|football]] club based in [[Třinec]], Czech Republic. It plays in the [[Czech National Football League]]. It is sponsored by the [[Třinec Iron and Steel Works]]; in the past the club bore the name of the company.

The club's highest achievement was the presence in the [[Czechoslovak First League]], where the club was present for six seasons in the 1960s and 1970s.<ref name=jerabek>{{cite book |last= Jeřábek|first=Luboš|title=Ceský a ceskoslovenský fotbal – lexikon osobností a klubu|year=2007|publisher=Grada Publishing|location=Prague|language=cs|isbn=978-80-247-1656-5|page=206}}</ref>"}}
